text: Design survey 2026-10-18 (Opus): core ≈1.6k lines {AtlasRef, AtlasRegistry, Region, Provenance, ParcelData, StandardAtlases, AtlasError(core cases), TransformKind/Status, trait Atlas, AtlasRealization contract}; deps locus4s core+data only. Prep in ScalaFIM first: split AtlasError foreign cases (TransformGraph/Transform/Geometry) into a ScalaFIM routing wrapper; delete dead StandardSurface.preferredKind and never-constructed DerivationStep.ProjectedVolumeToSurface (wire case stays); move publication members to a ScalaFIM PublishedAtlasRealization subtrait and factories to Volume/Surface companions; widen ParcelData.fromValues to Atlas. Package neuroatlas4s; no re-export shims; SpaceId->WorldSpace table deferred to routing. Persisted strings pinned by AtlasPublicationSuite digests must stay byte-identical. Starts after eco-u2-pins commits; public repo creation needs user approval; plsneuro (3 files) breaks at cutover.
